program.section_heading: Social-Emotional and Cognitive Development Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to examine mindsets, possible biases, and develop a vision for being an equity-driven educator.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to analyze curricula through a culturally relevant pedagogy lens.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to create a culturally sustaining classroom community that supports students’ social-emotional as well as academic learning.
Upon successful completion of the course, the student will be able to investigate academic standards related to social justice and equity in the classroom and beyond.

notes: Noncredit program counted in hours: the catalog says 'Core Courses-36 hours (Credits listed are in hours)' and prints 18 hours beside each course.
The block total is printed as '36 - 0' and each course as '18 - 0'; the trailing 0 looks like a display artifact for noncredit units, so the hours are recorded as 36 and 18.
The program total of 36 is taken from the only block's stated total ('Core Courses-36 hours'). The catalog prints no separate program total.
Course codes are printed without a space (EDUCB70NC, EDUCB71NC). They match closed-list EDUC B70NC and EDUC B71NC, so they are not marked as additions.
Outcome 4 says 'completion of the course' rather than 'of the program'; it is copied as printed.
The description says the certificate 'of achievement' courses, although the award is a Certificate of Completion.
'current and future educators' is the program's intended audience as named in the description; it is recorded as the career named.
